title: Seen article deduplication is not enforced at the database layer

evidence.quote: Used to prevent duplicate articles across digest runs.

reasoning: The model documents SeenArticle as the deduplication record, but the only database constraint on feed_id/guid is a non-unique index. That permits duplicate rows for the same article, especially under concurrent digest runs, so the persistence layer cannot guarantee the intended dedupe invariant.
recommendation: Change the feed_id/guid index to a unique constraint or unique index, and make insert paths handle the resulting integrity error idempotently.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the model-only evidence shows no database constraint that a test could rely on.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a database model test that inserts two SeenArticle rows with the same feed_id and guid and asserts the second insert fails or is handled idempotently by the repository/service API.
minimumFixScope: Update app/models/seen_article.py and add an Alembic migration that creates a unique index for feed_id/guid after deduplicating existing rows.
